title: BotRobotReadRequest
description: bot.robot-read-request@1: the query of bot.robot.read on OpenVibe.Bot (server/api/v1.js); the routes take no body. owner names whose robots GET /api/v1/robots lists (a service must give it; a person may give only their own subject). limit (1 to 200, default 50) and before (the last audit id seen) page GET …/robots/:id/audit.
